tool_input.description: Verify staged build files match output
tool_input.command: $build = 'D:\repository\苏住房G\worktrees\task2468-navbar-visual\dist'; $stage = 'D:\repository\苏住房G\worktrees\task2468-navbar-visual\.task-state\task-2468-navbar-dist'; foreach ($name in @('index.html','version.json')) { $source = Join-Path $build $name; $copy = Join-Path $stage $name; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $source) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $copy)) { throw "Missing $name in build or stage" }; $a = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $source -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; $b = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $copy -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; "${name}: $($a -eq $b)" }
